name: deploy_gate
description:
Port of the ole-eval deployment validation gate (code/eval/deploy_gate/gate.py):
a change to a served deployment may not ship unless every one of five checks
passes. The gate runs smoke, config, quality, perf and lmcache in that order and
returns PASS only when all five pass; otherwise it refuses and names the first
check that failed, so the operator sees the blocking check rather than a generic
red. That ladder -- which checks gate a ship, that all must pass, and the first
failure in the gate's own order -- is the decision this graph encodes.
One fold is documented: each check's own pass/fail is the observable input here.
Turning a measurement into pass/fail is threshold arithmetic over live-server
numbers that live in code/eval/deploy_gate/thresholds.json and is applied by the
harness that produces the check status (the smoke conditions, the config bounds
max_model_len >= 1048576 and the expected model id, the tier1 pass_rate >= 0.9 and
the deterministic golden match_rate >= 0.9, the per-context prefill/gen/ttft
bounds, the lmcache metrics 200 / valkey L2 dbsize > 0 / warm speedup >= 1.2). So
the graph is the gate's policy over five check outcomes, not the measurement.
Reference order (gate.py main()): results are appended smoke, config, quality,
perf, lmcache; `all_pass = all(status == "PASS")`, and the first non-PASS result
is the blocking check.

check.instructions: smoke: is the server up? /health returns 200, /v1/models lists at least one model, a chat completion reports ok, and its output is non-empty.

criteria.fail: at least one smoke condition failed

check.instructions: config: does the served model match the deployment? max_model_len is at least the required length and the model id is the expected one.

criteria.fail: max_model_len is below the bound, or the model id is not the expected one

check.instructions: quality: does the tier1 corpus pass the bar? pass_rate is at least the threshold, and when a golden file is present the deterministic match_rate is at least its threshold.

criteria.pass: the pass_rate, and any golden match, cleared their thresholds
criteria.fail: pass_rate, or a golden match, fell below its threshold

check.instructions: perf: is throughput good enough at every measured context? prefill and generation tokens/s are at least their floors and time-to-first-token is within its ceiling, for each context band.

criteria.pass: every context band met its prefill, generation and ttft bounds
criteria.fail: a context band missed a prefill, generation or ttft bound, or its measurement did not succeed

check.instructions: lmcache: is the shared KV cache link live end to end? the lmcache metrics endpoint is 200, the valkey L2 dbsize is above zero, and a warm request is faster than the cold one by at least the speedup floor. The last check: a pass here ships.

criteria.pass: the lmcache endpoint, the valkey L2 store and the warm speedup all held
criteria.fail: the endpoint, the L2 store or the warm speedup did not hold
